decisions.reason: The housing has its own page and supports the firm's core drainage portfolio, so management has committed to it visibly and will keep investing in it.
Floor-level shower drainage is central to the direction the firm has announced as a drainage specialist, so after only one year any weak results are treated as a temporary ramp-up.
The designer drain is presented prominently on its own page and is part of the bathroom line, so the investment in design and marketing calls for persistence.
The shower element is only mentioned on the website and is less visible, but it fits the floor-level shower strategy and early results are not yet conclusive.
The firm publicly announced this specifically developed backflow drain as its own development, a strong public commitment that management will defend.
